Counter vs rows seen: 4294 claimed vs 5 rows visible, 0 of them export-side. No export B/L with Indian-origin shipment, date and destination was obtained.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split was retrieved. The only counterparty data visible on ImportKey are foreign suppliers/buyers (e.g. "574 STEER JAPAN CORPORATION", "252 OSSBERGER LLC", "209 STEER AMERICA INC"), which are group/related entities, not evidence of domestic Indian supply.
note: Registry/catalogue data excluded per scope. ImportKey's free page is import-side only: the 4294-record counter and the 5 rendered rows all show Steer as Indian BUYER of plastic-processing machine parts under HS 84779000 from Czech Republic, Indonesia, USA, UAE — this confirms the company is an active operator in the declared HS 847790 family but is NOT evidence of export shipments. Export-side sources (volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com) returned HTTP 403 and seair.co.in returned 404; the web_search tool was unavailable (connection refused), so no export B/L could be located. Per Rule 5, the company's own site/catalogue claims are not counted as fact, so export_status and domestic_status are recorded as unknown rather than declared_only — no shipment record was seen either way. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN verified. HS codes 847720/847790 are consistent with the observed customs descriptions ("parts for machine of working plastic", "screw cap 123MM", "barrel liner for extruder ZE90"), so no HS correction is needed.
